decisive_spans.text: A 15 × 6 cm cystic mass with regular margins was found arising from the right tubo-ovarian complex
on incision of the cyst wall purulent fluid was noted

response.rationale: The presence of a cystic mass with purulent fluid directly supports Ovarian cyst and Ovarian cystitis. Ovarian cyst is slightly favored as it directly describes the mass and its contents, while Ovarian cystitis implies inflammation of the cyst, which is also present but less direct than the description of the cyst itself.
